name: linalg_cond
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_cond(Tensor self, Scalar? p=None) -> Tensor. Computes matrix condition numbers without mutating or aliasing self. Tests additionally exercise the registered aten::linalg_cond.p_str overload for fro and nuc, numeric square-matrix norms including infinities, rectangular p=2/-2 SVD paths using moderately conditioned float32 matrices, and explicit rejection of unsupported FlagGems autograd.
